items.title: Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw
items.raw_content: Received the following email from Anthropic: Hi, Starting April 4 at 12pm PT / 8pm BST, you’ll no longer be able to use your Claude subscription limits for third-party harnesses including OpenClaw. You can still use them with your Claude account, but they will require extra usage, a pay-as-you-go option billed separately from your subscription. Your subscription still covers all Claude products, including Claude Code and Claude Cowork. To keep using third-party harnesses with your Claude login, turn on extra usage for your account. This will be enforced April 4 starting with OpenClaw, but this policy applies to all third-party harnesses and will be rolled out to more shortly (read more). To make the transition easier, we’re offering a one-time credit for extra usage equal to your monthly subscription price. Redeem your credit by April 17. We’re also introducing discounts when you pre-pur
items.title_zh: Tell HN：Anthropic 不再允许 Claude Code 订阅额度用于 OpenClaw
items.summary: Anthropic told users that from April 4, Claude subscription limits will no longer cover third-party harnesses, beginning with OpenClaw, which will instead require separately billed pay-as-you-go extra usage. The company is offering a one-time credit equal to one month's subscription, redeemable by April 17, and says the policy will extend to more third-party harnesses.

items.title: Mathematical methods and human thought in the age of AI
items.title_zh: AI 时代的数学方法与人类思维
items.summary: The paper considers how AI is reshaping traditional philosophical questions, especially in mathematics, and questions the justifications for its rapid development given resource consumption and risks to skilled workers' livelihoods.

items.title: Cohere Transcribe: Speech Recognition
items.title_zh: Cohere Transcribe：语音识别
items.summary: Cohere introduced Transcribe, a speech-recognition product that converts business audio data into text for search, analytics and automation, claiming unmatched accuracy and speed.

items.title: The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode
items.title_zh: Claude Code 源码泄露剖析：假工具、挫败感正则与卧底模式

items.title: Is BGP safe yet?
items.title_zh: BGP 现在安全了吗？
items.summary: The site explains that BGP hijacks and misconfigurations can cause widespread security problems, and tracks how major ISPs, transit operators, and content providers are adopting RPKI and other route-signing technologies.

items.title: Email obfuscation: What works in 2026?
items.title_zh: 邮件地址混淆：2026 年哪些方法仍然有效？
items.summary: The article surveys techniques for hiding email addresses from spammers and offers statistics on how likely each is to be defeated. It recommends layering methods, for example splitting an address into parts each protected differently, so a harvester must break both.

items.title: Sweden goes back to basics, swapping screens for books in the classroom

items.summary: Undark reports that Sweden has pivoted away from screens in classrooms and invested in back-to-basics materials amid declining test scores.

items.title: Show HN: sllm – Split a GPU node with other developers, unlimited tokens
items.title_zh: Show HN：sllm —— 与其他开发者共享 GPU 节点，token 不限量
items.summary: sllm is a Show HN service that lets developers share a dedicated GPU node as a cohort, reserving a spot with a card and charging nothing until the cohort fills; prices start at $5/month for smaller models and the API is OpenAI-compatible via vLLM.

items.title: Finnish sauna heat exposure induces stronger immune cell than cytokine responses

items.summary: According to the paper title, heat exposure in a Finnish sauna induces a stronger immune cell response than cytokine responses.

items.title: Union types in C# 15
items.title_zh: C# 15 中的联合类型
items.summary: C# 15 adds union types, letting developers define a closed set of possible case types, convert to them implicitly and check every case exhaustively when matching. A preview is available.

items.title: 15 years, one server, 8GB RAM and 500k users – how Webminal refuses to die
items.title_zh: 15 年、一台服务器、8GB 内存、50 万用户：Webminal 为何还没倒下
items.summary: Webminal has run on a single CentOS server with 8GB of RAM since 2011, surviving a 2021 datacenter fire that cost it 150,000 user accounts, multiple power outages in the Netherlands, and a traffic surge from a Spanish tech blog.

items.summary: Mnemosyne is a zero-cloud AI memory system built on SQLite with a single pure-Python dependency, according to its repository.

items.title_zh: quip-validator：Quip 协议的 Rust 实现
items.summary: quip-validator is a Rust implementation of the Quip Protocol, forked from Substrate.

items.title: kunchenguid/no-mistakes
items.title_zh: kunchenguid/no-mistakes：git push no-mistakes
items.summary: No-mistakes is a Go project described only by the phrase "git push no-mistakes" in its repository.

items.title: Fast NF4 Dequantization Kernels for Large Language Model Inference
items.title_zh: 面向大语言模型推理的快速 NF4 反量化内核
items.summary: The authors present a shared-memory optimization for NF4 dequantization that keeps full HuggingFace ecosystem compatibility while using only 64 bytes of shared memory per thread block. Against BitsAndBytes it reports 2.0-2.2x kernel speedup on Gemma 27B, Qwen3 32B and Llama3.3 70B and up to 1.54x end-to-end improvement on current NVIDIA GPUs such as Ampere A100.

items.title: ARCS: Autoregressive Circuit Synthesis with Topology-Aware Graph Attention and Spec Conditioning
items.title_zh: ARCS：基于拓扑感知图注意力与规格条件的自回归电路综合
items.summary: ARCS combines a graph VAE, a flow-matching model, and SPICE-based ranking to generate complete, simulatable analog circuits in milliseconds, reporting 99.9% simulation validity across 32 topologies with eight SPICE evaluations.

items.title: A Dynamic Atlas of Persian Poetic Symbolism: Families, Fields, and the Historical Rewiring of Meaning
items.title_zh: 波斯诗歌象征的动态图谱：家族、场域与意义的历史重构
items.summary: Using 129,451 poems, the authors group recurrent symbolic forms into families and map them in a multi-layer graph across 11 Hijri-century bins, finding a sparse symbolic core and a denser referential layer. Night, Day, and Earth remain widely distributed, while wine, garden, and flame imagery strengthens later and courtly bridges weaken.

items.title: Review and Evaluation of Point-Cloud based Leaf Surface Reconstruction Methods for Agricultural Applications
items.title_zh: 农业应用中的点云叶片表面重建方法综述与评估
items.summary: A comparative study evaluates nine surface reconstruction methods for leaf surfaces on the LAST-STRAW, Pheno4D and Crops3D datasets, ranging from clean high-resolution indoor scans to noisy low-resolution field data. The authors report distinct trade-offs in surface-area accuracy, smoothness, noise robustness and computational cost, which bear on the hardware constraints of agricultural robots.

items.title: PolySwarm: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Prediction Market Trading and Latency Arbitrage
items.title_zh: PolySwarm：面向预测市场交易与延迟套利的多智能体 LLM 框架
items.summary: PolySwarm is a multi-agent LLM framework for prediction-market trading and latency arbitrage on Polymarket that deploys 50 LLM personas and combines their probability estimates with market-implied probabilities through confidence-weighted Bayesian aggregation. It applies quarter-Kelly position sizing and uses KL and JS divergence to detect cross-market inefficiencies and negation-pair mispricings.

items.title: Poisoned Identifiers Survive LLM Deobfuscation: A Case Study on Claude Opus 4.6
items.title_zh: 被投毒的标识符在 LLM 反混淆后依然存在：Claude Opus 4.6 案例研究
items.summary: Across 192 inference runs on two code archetypes, poisoned identifier names from obfuscated JavaScript persisted into Claude Opus 4.6's reconstructed code even when the model described the correct semantics. Reframing the task from deobfuscation to writing a fresh implementation reduced propagation from 100% to 0–20% on the physics archetype and to 0% on pathfinding, though the authors note the findings cover one model family.
